# Daily Update: AI Stocks Watchlist
1. Open/Close data for a list of stocks is retrieved from the FinnHub API.
2. Data is processed and constructed into a final payload.
3. Final payload is sent to a Discord server

nodes.name: tickerArr
nodes.notes: Add list of ticker symbols here.

nodes.name: FinnHubb
nodes.notes: An API call is made for every symbol in `tickerArr`

nodes.name: RenameKeys
nodes.notes: Renames the keys from the outputted json into usable words

nodes.name: FinalPayload
nodes.notes: Constructs final payload message using data from previous steps.

nodes.name: DiscordPOST
nodes.notes:
Sends final payload from previous message to discord server via webhook.

Will have to add discord webhook as an env variable. It highlights red but still works.
